response.overview: Deep within a forest, a small object emerges from the ground. This tiny, endearing character begins a journey through the deep woods, calling out to—and encountering—other similar objects along the way, eventually continuing the trek together. Though the destination is unknown, they are all headed toward a gathering, set to take place at a specific time and place. After a somewhat perilous journey, they arrive at a destination where they encounter countless other objects that look just like them.
response.title: Fireworks
